name: io.github.nubiia-dev/mcp-pipedrive
description: Complete Pipedrive CRM integration with 254 MCP tools for deals, contacts, and pipelines

environmentVariables.name: PIPEDRIVE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your Pipedrive API token (found in Settings → Personal Preferences → API)

environmentVariables.name: PIPEDRIVE_COMPANY_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Your Pipedrive company domain (e.g., 'mycompany' if your URL is mycompany.pipedrive.com)

environmentVariables.name: PIPEDRIVE_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of toolsets to enable (e.g., 'deals,persons,organizations')

environmentVariables.name: PIPEDRIVE_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to enable read-only mode (blocks all write operations)
